+# Extend Base.promote_shape for DenseAxisArray axes containing AbstractVectors
+# This enables operations like addition when axes are Vectors instead of UnitRanges
+function Base.promote_shape(
+    a::Tuple{Vararg{AbstractVector,N}},
+    b::Tuple{Vararg{AbstractVector,N}},
+) where {N}
+    for i in 1:N
+        if a[i] != b[i]
+            throw(
+                DimensionMismatch(
+                    "dimensions must match: a has dimension $i as $(a[i]), " *
+                    "got $(b[i])",
+                ),
+            )
+        end
+    end
+    return a
+end
+
+# Handle dimension mismatch between tuples of different lengths
+function Base.promote_shape(
+    a::Tuple{Vararg{AbstractVector,N}},
+    b::Tuple{Vararg{AbstractVector,M}},
+) where {N,M}
+    throw(
+        DimensionMismatch(
+            "arrays have incompatible dimensions: " *
+            "a has $N dimension(s), b has $M dimension(s)",
+        ),
+    )
+end
